mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(c.sign_amount, c.total_amount, c.amount, 0)), 0) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) FROM crm_opty o WHERE o.contact_id = #{contactId} AND () AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.opty_id = o.opty_id AND c.opty_id IS NOT NULL AND c.opty_id != '')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(c.sign_amount, c.total_amount, c.amount, 0)), 0) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId} AND c.sign_time IS NOT NULL AND c.sign_time >= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '365 days')
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(c.sign_time))::integer FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId} AND c.sign_time IS NOT NULL AND c.sign_time >= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '365 days')
SELECT MIN(c.sign_time) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId} AND c.sign_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT MAX(c.sign_time) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId} AND c.sign_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(c.sign_time))::integer FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.contact_id = #{contactId} AND c.sign_time IS NOT NULL

SELECT COALESCE(o.treatment_item_code, 'restorative') AS treatment_code, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount), 0) AS amount FROM crm_opty o WHERE o.contact_id = #{contactId} AND () GROUP BY COALESCE(o.treatment_item_code, 'restorative')

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sub.amount), 0) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT o.opty_id, o.amount FROM crm_opty o WHERE o.account_id = #{accountId} AND () AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.opty_id = o.opty_id AND c.opty_id IS NOT NULL AND c.opty_id != '') ) sub
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.pending_receivable), 0) FROM crm_contract c WHERE c.account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer FROM crm_contact WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT e.event_id AS campaign_id, COALESCE(e.paid, 0) AS spend, COUNT(DISTINCT l.contact_id)::integer AS converts FROM crm_event e LEFT JOIN crm_conversion_history ch ON ch.target_id = e.event_id AND ch.conversion_type = 'Marketing Event' LEFT JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = ch.lead_id AND l.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND l.contact_id != '' WHERE e.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY e.event_id, e.paid

SELECT b.bulk_id AS campaign_id, COALESCE(b.spend_amount, 0) AS spend, COUNT(DISTINCT l.contact_id)::integer AS converts FROM crm_bulkemail b LEFT JOIN crm_conversion_history ch ON ch.target_id = b.bulk_id AND ch.conversion_type = 'Email Marketing' LEFT JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = ch.lead_id AND l.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND l.contact_id != '' WHERE b.bulk_id = #{bulkId} GROUP BY b.bulk_id, b.spend_amount
SELECT e.event_id AS campaign_id, COALESCE(e.paid, 0) AS spend FROM crm_event e WHERE COALESCE(e.paid, 0) > 0
SELECT b.bulk_id AS campaign_id, COALESCE(b.spend_amount, 0) AS spend FROM crm_bulkemail b WHERE COALESCE(b.spend_amount, 0) > 0
mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT contact_id, event_id FROM ( SELECT ch.target_id AS contact_id, l.sid AS event_id FROM crm_conversion_history ch INNER JOIN crm_lead l ON l.lead_id = ch.lead_id WHERE ch.conversion_type = 'Contact' AND ch.target_id IS NOT NULL AND ch.target_id != '' AND l.sid IS NOT NULL AND l.sid != '' UNION SELECT ec.crm_contact_id, ec.crm_event_id FROM crm_wecom_external_contact ec WHERE ec.crm_contact_id IS NOT NULL AND ec.crm_contact_id != '' AND ec.crm_event_id IS NOT NULL AND ec.crm_event_id != '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT f.contact_id, COALESCE(a.context->>'crm_event_id', q.crm_event_id) AS event_id FROM crm_wechat_mp_fan f INNER JOIN crm_activity a ON ( a.context->>'openid' = f.open_id OR a.context->>'open_id' = f.open_id ) LEFT JOIN crm_wechat_mp_qrcode q ON q.crm_event_id IS NOT NULL AND (a.context->>'scene_str' = q.scene_str OR a.payload->>'event_key' = 'qrscene_' || q.scene_str) WHERE f.contact_id IS NOT NULL AND f.contact_id != '' AND (a.context->>'crm_event_id' IS NOT NULL OR q.crm_event_id IS NOT NULL) ) attributed WHERE contact_id IS NOT NULL AND contact_id != '' AND event_id IS NOT NULL AND event_id != ''
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_contact SET acquisition_cost = 0, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE crm_contact SET acquisition_cost = #{acquisitionCost}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE contact_id = #{contactId}
